iti7:1.1: (Ek. I.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttam-arahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti7:2.1: Sabbaṃ bhikkhave anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ tattha cittaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya. Sabbañca kho bhikkhave abhijānaṃ parijānaṃ tattha cittaṃ virājayaṃ pajahaṃ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāyā-ti. Etam-atthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetam iti vuccati:
iti7:3.1: Yo sabbaṃ sabbato ñatvā sabbatthesu na rajjati | sa ve sabbaṃ pariññā so sabbadukkhaṃ upaccagā ti ||
iti7:4.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||7||
